rules: No public schema, public migration ledger, historical staff migration ledger, old credentials or DB roles are imported.
Copy exact row bytes only from the frozen reviewed source snapshot and compare per-table counts and canonical row digests before unfreezing target.
Control rows require explicit new deployment/config binding and remain disabled until root activation; do not blindly copy enabled state.
StaffOperationsGrant is preserved evidence only: its old control/deployment binding cannot authorize a new release; issue a new reviewed grant only if needed.

CustomerIntakeDraft retains account/order header context; no CustomerIntakeCard/upload/identification/effect rows are copied. Financial receipt JSON is preserved, never interpreted as learning examples.
No authentication sessions/challenges/browser secrets are copied; retained phoneHash/account IDs remain compatible when the existing phone hash key is retained securely.
Reference cache is optional and excluded by default: import only after proving new independent policy provenance and no human corrections, card images or Ten Kings dependency.

Assert every physical-card/derivative and learning membership/publication/history table is zero on source and destination; source neutral control/release rows may exist only with zero membership and are not copied; a nonzero source count blocks the copy plan rather than silently discarding unexpected records.

Neutral learning release/control is a new explicit zero-membership release binding created by the release operator after empty-schema validation; no old release/member/publication/history rows copied.

No blanket trigger disabling. A table whose historical rows cannot satisfy immutable insertion triggers needs an exact scoped, separately reviewed import transaction with post-import FK/trigger restoration proof.
Reconcile current financial/provider pending work before quiescence; immutable receipts are retained while actionable effects are not dispatched until explicit activation.

geometry_claim_capacity is global coordination, not card evidence: do not import its old lease/counter; initializeStandaloneCoordination must explicitly insert the reviewed concurrency1..12 before runtime readiness; no implicit runtime default exists.
